text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎来到《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎來到《Real Easy English》。

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 我们进行真实对话的播客
zh_hant: 我們進行真實對話的播客

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil, and with me is Georgie.
zh: 我是尼尔,和我在一起的是乔治。
zh_hant: 我是尼爾,和我在一起的是喬治。

text: Hello.
Did you know that you can now watch a video of this podcast?
zh: 你知道吗,现在你可以观看这个播客的视频了。
zh_hant: 你知道嗎,現在你可以觀看這個播客的影片了。

text: And you can read along with a transcript on our website.
zh: 你也可以在我们的网站上一边听一边看文字稿。
zh_hant: 你也可以在我們的網站上一邊聽一邊看文字稿。

text: Visit bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Georgie.
How are you?
I'm very well, thank you, Neil.
How are you?
How was your journey into work?
My journey into work was very good today, actually.
zh: 说实话，我今天上班的路上很顺利。
zh_hant: 說實話，我今天上班的路上很順利。

text: And we're actually talking about transport today.
zh: 今天我们实际上要谈论的是交通运输。
zh_hant: 今天我們實際上要談論的是交通運輸。

text: How was your journey to work?
My journey was quite easy this morning, actually.
zh: 说实话,我今天早上的旅程相当轻松。
zh_hant: 說實話,我今天早上的旅程相當輕鬆。

text: It isn't always.
And, Neil, we actually have a very similar commute, don't we?
zh: Neil,我们上下班的路线其实很相似,对吧?
zh_hant: Neil,我們上下班的路線其實很相似,對吧?

text: I get the Tube
to work,
which in the UK is the underground train.
So I walk to the station around 15 to 20 minutes,
zh: 我走到车站大概要十五到二十分钟。
zh_hant: 我走到車站大概要十五到二十分鐘。

text: and then I get the underground train, one train,
zh: 然后我坐地铁,坐一趟车,
zh_hant: 然後我坐地鐵,坐一趟車,

text: and then I change and then get another one, and then I walk to work.
zh: 然后我换衣服,再吃一个,接着走路去上班。
zh_hant: 然後我換衣服,再吃一個,接著走路去上班。

text: What about you?
I do that, but before,
zh: 不过在那之前,我会那么做的
zh_hant: 不過在那之前,我會那麼做的

text: your bit,
I have to get a bus as well.
Are you that far away from the station?
A couple of miles.
OK.
Three kilometres.
A bit too far to walk, then.
zh: 那走路去就有点太远了。
zh_hant: 那走路去就有點太遠了。

text: A bit too far to walk.
I have walked when the public
transport has been unreliable.
But normally I get the bus
to the Tube stop,
and then I get on the Tube into work.
Lovely.
And do you like the Tube?
What do you think about it?
I think the Tube
is very convenient,
actually, because the trains go
very frequently.
So if you miss one, you can wait
zh: 如果你错过了一班,可以等下一班
zh_hant: 如果你錯過了一班,可以等下一班

text: just a couple of minutes and get the next one.
zh: 再等几分钟就能看下一集了。
zh_hant: 再等幾分鐘就能看下一集了。

text: And it's probably the quickest way to get
zh: 最快的方法可能就是这样了
zh_hant: 最快的方法可能就是這樣了

text: into central London
because there's so much traffic.
Driving is a really bad idea.
zh: 开车是个非常糟糕的主意。
zh_hant: 開車是個非常糟糕的主意。

text: Yeah, I agree with you.
It is very reliable .
It's usually very easy.
The thing I don't like about it, especially in the morning
zh: 我不喜欢它的一点是,尤其是在早上
zh_hant: 我不喜歡它的一點是,尤其是在早上

text: at rush hour,
is the number of people on the Tube.
The, the underground trains in London are very old.
They're very small.
And they are very crowded in the mornings.
So crowded means there's lots of people.
zh: 拥挤"就是人很多的意思。
zh_hant: 擁擠"就是人很多的意思。

text: We can also say packed .
Yeah.
And I really don't like being in a tight space
zh: 我真的很不喜欢待在狭小的空间里
zh_hant: 我真的很不喜歡待在狹小的空間裡

text: with lots of people in the mornings,
so early in the morning.
Yeah, I agree,
but I'm lucky because I get on the Tube at the first stop,
zh: 但我很幸运,因为我是从第一站上车的。
zh_hant: 但我很幸運,因為我是從第一站上車的。

text: so I always get a seat, but then
zh: 但这样我总能有座位,不过
zh_hant: 但這樣我總能有座位,不過

text: by the time you get on,
it is usually really packed .
And the closer you get into central London,
the more packed it is.
You're squashed up against strangers.
zh: 你被挤得和陌生人贴在一起。
zh_hant: 你被擠得和陌生人貼在一起。

text: It's not always fun.
I hate it.
What about buses?
Do you like buses?
are OK.
They, in London again, they are quite frequent .
zh: 他们又在伦敦了,这种情况相当频繁。
zh_hant: 他們又在倫敦了,這種情況相當頻繁。

text: And that's convenient.
Not always.
I mean, they are, they're frequent ,
zh: 我是说,它们确实,它们经常出现,
zh_hant: 我是說,它們確實,它們經常出現,

text: but they're more unreliable than trains, aren't they?
zh: 但它们比火车更不可靠,不是吗?
zh_hant: 但它們比火車更不可靠,不是嗎?

text: There always seems to be roadworks near where I live,
zh: 我家附近好像总是在修路。
zh_hant: 我家附近好像總是在修路。

text: and when there are roadworks,
zh: 而且当有道路施工的时候,
zh_hant: 而且當有道路施工的時候,

text: there are traffic lights and then there are delays on the buses.
zh: 有红绿灯,公交车也会晚点。
zh_hant: 有紅綠燈,公交車也會晚點。

text: So in the city, public transport
can be great.
But what about when we go outside of the city?
zh: 那我们去城外的时候呢?
zh_hant: 那我們去城外的時候呢?

text: What do you use to go to other parts of the UK?
zh: 你用什么交通工具去英国其他地方?
zh_hant: 你用什麼交通工具去英國其他地方?

text: If it's quite far, so if I'm going really far north,
zh: 如果距离相当远,比如我要往北走很远的话,
zh_hant: 如果距離相當遠,比如我要往北走很遠的話,

text: maybe to Scotland or to, I don't know,
zh: 也许去苏格兰,或者去,我也不知道
zh_hant: 也許去蘇格蘭,或者去,我也不知道

text: Manchester or a northern city,
zh: 曼彻斯特或北方的一座城市
zh_hant: 曼徹斯特或北方的一座城市

text: it's probably better to get the train
because it's faster and I really like trains.
zh: 因为这样更快,而且我真的很喜欢火车。
zh_hant: 因為這樣更快,而且我真的很喜歡火車。

text: You can relax.
It's a relaxing experience.
zh: 这是一次令人放松的体验。
zh_hant: 這是一次令人放鬆的體驗。

text: Some of my best travel experiences
zh: 我最棒的一些旅行经历
zh_hant: 我最棒的一些旅行經歷

text: have been on long distance trains.
Yeah?
Can you...
Where have you been that's been so fantastic on a train?
zh: 你坐火车去过哪些特别棒的地方?
zh_hant: 你坐火車去過哪些特別棒的地方?

text: Well, I once went
from Prague to Moscow on a train.
zh: 从布拉格坐火车到莫斯科。
zh_hant: 從布拉格坐火車到莫斯科。

text: Wow.
Yeah.
What was that like?
Really exciting.
Why?
It took about three days,
and I was with some friends,
and we could eat and drink and look out the window.
zh: 我们可以边吃边喝,还能看看窗外。
zh_hant: 我們可以邊吃邊喝,還能看看窗外。

text: The landscape changed frequently.
It was just
exciting.
We had reliable ,
which describes something you can trust,
zh: 这形容一种你可以信赖的东西,
zh_hant: 這形容一種你可以信賴的東西,

text: and unreliable which describes something you can't trust.
zh: 不可靠,形容不能信任的东西。
zh_hant: 不可靠,形容不能信任的東西。

text: We heard frequent ,
which describes something that happens often.
And we also heard delayed , which means something,
zh: 而且我们还听到了 delayed(延迟)这个词,它是有意义的,
zh_hant: 而且我們還聽到了 delayed(延遲)這個詞,它是有意義的,

text: like public transport, comes later than expected.
zh: 像公共交通一样,来得比预期晚。
zh_hant: 像公共交通一樣,來得比預期晚。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: Don't forget to go to our website where you can get a free worksheet
zh: 别忘了去我们的网站,你可以在那里免费获取一份练习题。
zh_hant: 別忘了去我們的網站,你可以在那裡免費獲取一份練習題。

text: to download to test what you've learnt.
zh: 下载以测试你所学到的内容。
zh_hant: 下載以測試你所學到的內容。

text: It's at bbclearningenglish.com.
Next time, we're talking about different times of year.
zh: 下次,我们要谈谈一年中的不同时节。
zh_hant: 下次,我們要談談一年中的不同時節。

text: Spring, summer, autumn and winter.
See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
